name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: Keys in the mono stack with a pressed bottom edge.

files.content:
/* ── Kbd: keys in the mono stack with a pressed bottom edge ── */
.rs-kbd{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-secondary);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--divider);border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 6px;line-height:1.2}
